note: The original describes only the soldier and gives the holotype measurements, with no description of the alate or worker; the apex of the right mandible of the holotype is damaged. Translated from the original description of Krishna & Emerson 1962.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text:
The soldier differs from G. palauensis in the far more prominent tubercle at the outer base of the mandibles, the weaker median constriction of the postmentum and the different overall shape. Compared with G. nissanensis the head is shorter, the frontal surface less steeply sloping, the postmentum shorter, the anterior margin of the pronotum more shallowly concave and the posterolateral margins straight. Compared with G. taveuniensis the head is shorter, the tubercle at the outer base of the mandibles indistinct, the postmentum shorter, the pronotum wider and the posterolateral margins evenly rounded. Compared with G. lighti the mandibles are shorter, the tubercle at the outer base of the mandibles indistinct, the postmentum more strongly constricted and the posterior margin of the pronotum concave.

The type locality is Hog Harbour, Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu (15°15′S, 167°0′E); the holotype is 1 soldier, nymphs were also collected, by K. P. Schmidt on 5 April 1929 (month 4) during the Crane Pacific Expedition. The species is named after Dr. K. P. Schmidt, Chief Curator of the Department of Zoology, Chicago Natural History Museum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head brown, reddish brown near the frontoclypeal suture and around the antennal sockets; mandibles reddish brown and shiny; pronotum pale brown, paler than the head, with dark spots on the disc; antennae, legs and nota pale brown. Head sparsely covered with erect setae, the margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae. Head short, the sides parallel; anterodorsal projection indistinct; frontal surface sloping at about 45° in profile. Eyes small, oval. Mandibles short, distinctly raised at the outer base; left mandible with 3 indistinct marginal teeth, the first and second close together, the posterior margin of the second tooth and the anterior margin of the third forming a concave cutting edge; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth (apex damaged in the holotype). Postmentum short, not strongly constricted in the middle. Antennae 11-segmented, segment 2 longer than segments 3 and 4, segment 3 shorter than segment 4. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, the anterior margin angular, the sides parallel, the posterolateral margins nearly straight and meeting the straight posterior margin at an angle. Femora slender.

Measurements of the holotype soldier: head length (to mandibular base) 1.35 mm; head width 0.98 mm; head height 0.90 mm; left mandible length 0.64 mm; postmentum maximum width 0.39 mm, minimum width 0.23 mm, length 0.83 mm; pronotum median length 0.49 mm, maximum length 0.54 mm, width 0.94 mm; hind tibia length 0.68 mm.
